subject: Proposal: 9-month stepped hosted-API commit + dynamic rate caps
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: ayesha.khan@acmeinc.com, martin.perez@acmeinc.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning: hosted-API commit + seasonal bursts

Hi Ayesha / Martin —

Great speaking earlier. Per our call I put together a compact proposal to align on Acme Commerce's usage growth for the next 9 months. The core idea: a stepped monthly commit that increases over three tranches, with a small seasonal burst pool and a dynamic rate cap to protect against spike costs.

High level:
- Months 1–3: 2.0M tokens/mo commit (base rate band)
- Months 4–6: 3.5M tokens/mo commit (mid band)
- Months 7–9: 5.0M tokens/mo commit (peak)
- Seasonal burst pool: additional 1.5M tokens available per month, billed at discounted burst rate if used
- Dynamic rate caps: per-route soft throttle at 120 rps for non-critical routing, high-priority routes pinned to 400 rps in Dedicated pools

I've attached a spreadsheet with monthly token simulations and cost estimates (redwood_commit_schedule_v2.xlsx). If this looks reasonable I can draft a short amendment and request approvals from our pricing team.

Questions for you: 1) Do you need the burst to be shared across routes or pinned per service? 2) Any governance constraints around automatic throttling (you mentioned SLAs earlier)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 30-min follow up tomorrow.

— Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@acmeinc.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: martin.perez@acmeinc.com, ops@acmeinc.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: hosted-API commit + seasonal bursts

Thanks Jasmine — this reads well. A few clarifications before we move legal/procurement: 

1) Burst scope: prefer burst pool to be shared across the account, not pinned per route. We run multiple ephemeral features that spike unpredictably.
2) Throttling: we can't accept hard throttles that drop requests; soft throttles with queuing or graceful 429s are ok. Any throttles must respect our SLA for the payments route (latency 95th < 250ms).
3) Contract term: can we convert the 9-month stepped schedule into a 12-month renewal with the first 9 months matching your tranches and months 10–12 at the M6 commit level (3.5M)?

Also Martin asked if you can show a scenario where we hit a 40% month-over-month growth for two months — what would the cost delta look like? If you can send a simulation, we can loop in procurement.

Ayesha
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Commerce

Hi team — attached are two files: acme_rate_simulations.csv (contains the growth and burst scenarios) and redwood_commit_schedule_v2.xlsx (updated with the 12-month mapping per Ayesha's ask). Summary below: 

- 12-month mapping: months 10–12 set at 3.5M tokens/mo. Amendment includes an explicit clause that seasonal burst is account-wide and billed at the burst-rate when consumed.
- High-growth scenario (40% MoM x2): if Acme sustains that for two months starting from baseline M3 (2.0M), peak usage would hit ~3.92M in month 2 of growth. Under the stepped commit, the burst would cover ~1.5M and net overage billed at the burst rate — estimated delta $8.4k for that month (see CSV).
- Throttling: propose soft-throttle configuration with prioritized routing for payments endpoint and a guaranteed 400 rps for that route; other routes default to 120 rps with queueing/backpressure. Ops confirms we can instrument per-route SLA telemetry.

Next steps proposed: 
1) Jasmine — send the one-page amendment and a short summary email to procurement (Ayesha + finance).
2) Lauren — please prepare the redlines template for legal, highlight the burst clause and the dynamic rate-cap language.

Ben Carter
Head of Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Ayesha / Martin — attaching the one-page amendment (see link below) and the updated schedule. Highlights: 
- 12-month term enabled; months 1–9 follow the stepped commits as discussed; months 10–12 at 3.5M tokens/mo.
- Shared seasonal burst pool: 1.5M tokens/mo, account-wide, billed at burst rate upon consumption.
- Soft-throttle behavior defined; payments route pinned to 400 rps guaranteed.
- Overage handling: automatic usage alerting at 85% of commit, and 30-day notice for sustained >120% usage outside bursts before any pricing reevaluation.
